Title: Establishes the indigenous black carbon recovery and clean energy manufacturing pilot program in the capital district and adjoining regions; appropriation
Summary: Establishes the indigenous black carbon recovery and clean energy manufacturing pilot program in the capital district and adjoining regions.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to establishing the indigenous black carbon recovery and clean energy manufacturing pilot program in the capital district and adjoining regions; and making an appropriation therefor
